camel_example: aliyun cms CreateDynamicTagGroup --region cn-hangzhou --MatchExpress.1.TagName appname --ContactGroupList.1 ECS_Group --MatchExpress.1.TagValue instance --TagKey ecs_instance --MatchExpress.1.TagValueMatchFunction contains
description_en: Automatically creates an application group based on tags
description_zh: 调用CreateDynamicTagGroup接口通过标签自动创建应用分组
kebab_example: aliyun cms create-dynamic-tag-group --tag-key ecs_instance --contact-group-list ECS_Group --match-express TagName=appname TagValue=instance TagValueMatchFunction=contains --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDynamicTagGroup

parameters.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.

For more information about how to query the tag keys of resources, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签键。

关于如何查询资源的标签键，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145558.html
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The alert contact groups. Valid values of N: 1 to 100. Alert notifications for the application group are sent to the alert contacts in the alert contact groups.

An alert contact group contains one or more alert contacts. For more information about how to create alert contacts and alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html. For more information about how to query alert contact groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警联系组。N的取值范围：1~100。应用分组的报警通知会发送给该报警联系组中的报警联系人。

报警联系组是一组报警联系人，可以包含一个或多个报警联系人。关于如何创建报警联系人和报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114923.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114929.html。关于如何获取报警联系组，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114922.html
parameters.name: contact_group_list

fields.help_en: The tag key used to create the group. If multiple resources contain this key, the resources that meet the filter conditions are added to the same group based on the same key-value pair
fields.help_zh: 用来创建分组的Tag的Key。如果包含此Key的资源有多个，那么会根据过滤条件，把符合的资源按相同的Key-Value，添加到相同的分组内
fields.name: tag_name

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1.

You must specify both the `MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction` and `MatchExpress.N.TagValue` parameters
fields.help_zh:
资源标签值。N取值为1。

参数`MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction`和`MatchExpress.N.TagValue`必须同时设置
fields.name: tag_value

fields.help_en:
The matching method for the tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1. Valid values:
contains: includes the specified value
startWith: starts with the specified value
endWith: ends with the specified value
notContains: does not include the specified value
equals: equals the specified value
all: all values

You must specify both the `MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction` and `MatchExpress.N.TagValue` parameters
fields.help_zh:
资源标签值的匹配方法。N的取值为1。取值：
contains：包含。
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀。
notContains：不包含。
equals：等于。
all：全部。

参数`MatchExpress.N.TagValueMatchFunction`和`MatchExpress.N.TagValue`必须同时设置
fields.name: tag_value_match_function

parameters.help_en: The matching expression used to generate the application group based on tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签生成应用分组的匹配表达式
parameters.name: match_express

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the tag
parameters.name: tag_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic subscription to event notifications for the application group. When critical or warning events occur on resources in the application group, CloudMonitor sends alert notifications. Valid values:

true: Enables automatic subscription.

false: Disables automatic subscription. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动订阅事件通知。当应用分组内资源发生严重和警告级别的事件时，云监控发送报警通知。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_subscribe_event

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic installation of the CloudMonitor agent for the application group. CloudMonitor automatically installs the CloudMonitor agent on the hosts in the application group. Valid values:

true: Enables automatic installation.

false: Disables automatic installation. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
应用分组是否开启自动安装云监控插件。云监控自动为应用分组内的主机安装云监控插件。取值：

true：开启。

false（默认值）：关闭
parameters.name: enable_install_agent

parameters.help_en:
The relationship between the conditional expressions of the resource tag values. Valid values:

and: Uses the AND logical operator. This is the default value.
or: Uses the OR logical operator
parameters.help_zh:
资源标签值的条件表达式之间的关系。取值：

and（默认值）：和。
or：或
parameters.name: match_express_filter_relation

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the alert templates.

For more information about how to query the IDs of alert templates, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.help_zh:
报警模板ID。

关于如何查询报警模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114982.html
parameters.name: template_id_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without creating the application group. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false: Performs a dry run and sends the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the application group is created. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建队列。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建队列
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
A status code of 200 indicates success

Id.description_en: The ID of the tag matching rule

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
